name: commit
description: Format-aware atomic commits for git and jj (Jujutsu). One skill covering commit, split, message review, and retrofitting edits into earlier commits (jj absorb / git fixup). Auto-detects VCS and commit message style from repo context. Includes PreToolUse hook that blocks destructive working-copy operations.

interface.longDescription: Format-aware atomic commit workflows for Git and Jujutsu.
